verdict.tagline: Chaotic stick figure brawler built for wild multiplayer laughs.
for_you_if: you want chaotic couch battles with friends
you love unpredictable physics driven combat
not_for_you_if: you struggle to connect with online players
you want reliable matchmaking without errors

cohorts.label: <2h refund window
cohorts.summary: Early reviewers report empty lobbies, missing crossplay, and connection errors when trying to play online.

claims.claim: Reviewers report difficulty finding online matches due to low player counts or empty lobbies.

citations.review_text: Sure, this game would've been great back then. Instantly when you first install the game, it feels very outdated. The whole point for me to get this was to be able to play with randoms but either it's a server issue or this game is extremely dead. You're better off playing idle games than having to wait hours for one person to join your lobby. I'm sure it's good with friends, tho having no updates and not that much content, it gets boring quickly.

i used to love this on mobile, but ever since it got shut down the game doesnt really have the same vibe it had before. the gameplay is good but the community is extremely dead thus online play will just be waiting in an empty lobby 20% of the time. i have nothing else to add. aside from the game being dead stuff its a solid 8.5/10

claims.claim: Reviewers point out that the game lacks crossplay.

citations.review_text: No updates in years, limited modding content, and no crossplay. Fun, but only for a little while. I recommend this as a local play game on a console if you own one and have siblings or friends over as a quick time waster, that's about it.
its fun to play but theres no crossplay when is it going to come??

claims.claim: Reviewers experience connection errors and invite failures when trying to play with friends online.

citations.review_text: Game itself looks cool and promising, but i bought it with my friend, but constantly when i try to play with him, i get the error "No connection to the host could be made, please check firewall, press enter for help". We literally spent hours trying to fix it without any luck, we tried disabling the firewall, enabling UPnP, port fowarding and more, but still it wont work.
Netcode is so bad, cant even invite friends. Firewall errors even though everything is enabled.

claims.claim: Reviewers mention issues with gamepads failing to be correctly detected via Remote Play.

citations.review_text:
Great game. Everyone I've played it with has really enjoyed it. It easily provides an hour of engaging gameplay. It's a lot of fun and very interesting.

Sometimes there are issues with correctly detecting gamepads via Remote Play, but usually somehow it gets fixed.

[h2]Nota Geral | Overall Rating[/h2]
⭐⭐⭐

[b]Stick Fight: The Game é a definição de diversão simples e caótica com amigos. Não existe pretensão nenhuma aqui: são bonecos de palito se socando, atirando e usando cenário de forma física até só sobrar um em pé. O jogo entrega exatamente o que promete no título, e para uma noite de resenha com amigos, cumpre muito bem seu papel. Fora desse contexto específico, a experiência perde bastante força.[/b]

[i]Stick Fight: The Game is the definition of simple, chaotic fun with friends. There's no pretension here at all: it's stick figures punching, shooting, and using the environment physically until only one is left standing. The game delivers exactly what it promises in the title, and for a night hanging out with friends, it does its job very well. Outside that specific context, the experience loses a lot of its strength.[/i]

[h2]Jogabilidade | Gameplay[/h2]
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

[b]A física exagerada e imprevisível é o que faz o jogo funcionar tão bem. Cada arma se comporta de um jeito diferente e muitas vezes ridículo, e o cenário interativo, com plataformas que caem, armadilhas e objetos que podem ser usados contra os oponentes, garante que nenhuma partida seja igual à outra. É simples de aprender e difícil de ficar entediado enquanto estiver jogando em grupo, o que é exatamente a proposta.[/b]

[i]The exaggerated, unpredictable physics is what makes the game work so well. Each weapon behaves in a different and often ridiculous way, and the interactive environment, with platforms that collapse, traps, and objects that can be used against opponents, ensures no match plays out the same way twice. It's easy to learn and hard to get bored of while playing in a group, which is exactly the point.[/i]

[h2]Duração | Duration[/h2]
⭐⭐⭐

[b]Sozinho, o jogo cansa rápido, já que a graça está diretamente ligada à imprevisibilidade de jogar contra pessoas reais. Em grupo, o tempo de vida é bem maior, mas ainda assim é o tipo de jogo …

awesome game, im on limited hardware so all of my issues may just be for me, but the online is kind of glitchy and even outright wont load at all.
either way, fun game none the less

Punch along with your movement for extra momentum 

There’s a persistent glitch in public lobbies that makes players immortal, keeping other players from winning because they fall into the void but the game thinks they’re alive, I don’t know if it’s intentional or not

Second, when picking up a weapons you can jump again. Third, to jump higher you must jump, punch, block in succession. Finale, get rid of weapons you are not using or planning to. (This may also tune down the chaos, chaos.)

This game was really fun when it first came out, but the last few times I've played it, there were a lot of bugs. That can sometimes be fun, but usually it's just annoying, like the round never ending and being forced to restart, or not being able to pick up weapons. It's a shame the developers haven't done anything to fix it in years.

the game is definetly outdated in terms of connection issues. That's about it. Its a lot of stuff you can do in this game and its always been an enjoyable experience whether it be with friends or in random lobbies. Plus for me specifically, the way the characters ragdoll as they're trying to destroy each other whilst the map is pretty much crumbling around them always amused me. That said, if you really want to play this game seriously, the skill gap isnt that high, just learn how to parry n stuff. Very enjoyable game even after all this time.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that online public lobbies contain cheaters and hackers.

citations.review_text:
I gotta say, this game was fun... in the past.

But now it's a different story. Every game I play there is a bug or something incredibly wacky happening with someone either from hacks or the game itself. Not to mention Landfall refuses to update the game to fix any problems. This game is stuck in the past and it's dying out.

Pretty Good fighting, sometimes bad lag but not too much, some cheaters but don't let that ruin your fun. Some tips if you want them. First, throw weapon's to refill your ammo. Second, when picking up a weapons you can jump again. Third, to jump higher you must jump, punch, block in succession. Finale, get rid of weapons you are not using or planning to. (This may also tune down the chaos, chaos.)

Picked this up to play with a couple friends and honestly it delivered way more laughs than I expected. The ragdoll physics and random weapon spawns make every round feel chaotic in the best way, and the maps collapsing mid-fight never stops being funny. That said, the game has clearly been abandoned by the devs so the online lobbies are pretty much hacker central now, and the map variety gets stale fast. If you have 3-4 friends willing to hop in together it's absolutely worth it, but don't bother with public matchmaking.
